edges.parent_basis:
Two acts on this line in this order. This one DOES recite an earlier station --
Pascite gregem Dei, by title and date -- but not the station immediately before
it, so the edge drawn is the weak one and the recitation is recorded in `effect`
rather than dressed as the basis of an edge it does not support.
